partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Dual-target dual-driver physical bridge
results.hypothesis: A drug can suppress a disease module when two distinct inhibited targets independently contact two distinct top-ranked causal disease drivers.
results.body: drug decreases two bound targets; each target directly interacts with a different top-three causal driver
results.mechanism_rationale: Two intervention arms reach two independent causal drivers and avoid dependence on one interaction hub, but driver-specific disease direction is not encoded.
results.trapi_notes: The repeated target, effect, interaction, and disease paths are TRAPI-expressible; distinct-node constraints, rank, and ontology filters require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target1:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect1:AFFECTS]->(target1)
MATCH (target1)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(driver1:Gene)
MATCH (driver1)-[evidence1:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target2:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect2:AFFECTS]->(target2)
MATCH (target2)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(driver2:Gene)
MATCH (driver2)-[evidence2:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
WHERE target1.id < target2.id
  AND driver1.id < driver2.id
  AND target1 <> driver1
  AND target2 <> driver2
  AND effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence1._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND evidence2._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.hypothesis: Increasing both targets in the same dual-driver topology is a matched directional control.
results.body: R384 topology with both target effects increased
results.mechanism_rationale: The nonlinear topology is retained, but generic activation is not expected to suppress the disease module.

results.name: Compact-process dual-target dual-driver bridge
results.hypothesis: The dual-arm physical bridge is more coherent when both causal drivers participate in the same compact biological process.
results.body: R384 plus both causal drivers share a process with at most 100 gene members
results.mechanism_rationale: Two inhibited targets independently reach two causal drivers in one bounded process, creating a four-gene nonlinear disease-module mechanism.
results.trapi_notes: The positive topology is TRAPI-expressible; repeated-node identity, process degree, rank, and ontology filters require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target1:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect1:AFFECTS]->(target1)
MATCH (target1)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(driver1:Gene)
MATCH (driver1)-[evidence1:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target2:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect2:AFFECTS]->(target2)
MATCH (target2)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(driver2:Gene)
MATCH (driver2)-[evidence2:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)

MATCH (driver1)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process:BiologicalProcess)
      <-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(driver2)
WHERE target1.id < target2.id
  AND driver1.id < driver2.id
  AND target1 <> driver1
  AND target2 <> driver2
  AND effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence1._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND evidence2._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
